description: Governor's Secretariat - Southern Province - Four Official Including Mrs. C. B. Abayadeera have been appointed to positions in the Southern Province
categorisation: This gazette contains only government personnel changes (appointments to specific positions) with named individuals and their basic titles/designations (e.g., "Deputy Chief Secretary," "Governor's Secretary"). It does not include detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or subject matter areas, which would be required for a Hybrid (Type 3) classification. The content focuses exclusively on who is being appointed to which positions and when, fitting the definition of a People Gazette.
